before.title: base A on / upon B
before.content: A 根據 B 為基礎

after.content: 把 A 建立在 B 的基礎上。

facts.reason: Clarify the actual base-A-on-B relation without altering the title, type or status.

before.title: (That's) a likely story!
before.content: 說得倒像是真的一樣／聽起來像真的一樣

after.content: （反諷，表示不相信）說得倒像真的一樣！

facts.reason: Make the disbelief explicit for this idiom, preserving its existing Chinese intent.
